Added missing localizations for the long‑press custom DeviceKey sheet in `miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings`, covering title/message/confirm across all supported locales.

The long‑press dialog is the “custom DeviceKey” entry sheet. Long‑pressing the current key opens a sheet where the user can enter a custom DeviceKey. On submit, it trims/validates the input, requires an existing current key, then calls `MiataruAPIClient.setDeviceKey` to update the server, updates local settings, clears the auth block, and restarts tracking if enabled.  
```146:306:miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DeviceKeySheetView.swift
Text(settings.deviceKey ?? "")
    .onLongPressGesture {
        showCustomKeySheet = true
    }

.sheet(isPresented: $showCustomKeySheet) {
    DeviceKeyEntrySheet(
        titleKey: "device_key_custom_title",
        messageKey: "device_key_custom_message",
        confirmKey: "device_key_custom_confirm",
        initialValue: settings.deviceKey ?? ""
    ) { enteredKey in
        await setCustomDeviceKey(enteredKey)
    }
}

private func setCustomDeviceKey(_ enteredKey: String) async -> String? {
    let trimmed = enteredKey.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
    if let error = validateDeviceKey(trimmed) { ... }
    guard let currentKey = settings.deviceKey, !currentKey.isEmpty else { ... }
    let result = await performSetDeviceKey(currentKey: currentKey, newKey: trimmed)
    ...
}
```
